cash_property_equipment_additions.sign_convention: Positive spending magnitude; financial statement presents an investing cash outflow

cfo_less_cash_property_equipment_additio.limitation: Narrow cash-flow scale measure; not adjusted for all lease economics, acquisitions, stock compensation or project cash flows.

common_shares_outstanding.scope: Actual common shares; not weighted-average diluted EPS denominator

permitted_use: METHOD: A hypothetical project NPV in USD million divided by 7425.545491 million shares produces a scale illustration in USD per share. Project NPV divided by annual cash-flow measures compares a stock with a flow and is only a size reference.
limitations: An illustrative after-tax unlevered project NPV is not a calibrated incremental common-equity value: actual taxes, financing, ownership, net debt, leases, contractual costs and other corporate effects need reconciliation.
No share-price target, current share count, company forecast, or Microsoft project valuation follows from these denominators.
Do not multiply a hypothetical unit-project result by the number of tracker records.
